title: Detail Service Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Vehicle Detailing Service: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Detail Service Estimate Worksheet covers vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature. The detail service advisor records Vehicle Detailing Service observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Detail Service Estimate Worksheet keeps Vehicle Detailing Service exceptions visible until the detail service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Detail Service Estimate Worksheet at detail bay, wash area, interior work zone, drying area, and delivery point. Document vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature identity before Vehicle Detailing Service begins. Compare vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature findings with stated Vehicle Detailing Service criteria; route unresolved Vehicle Detailing Service issues to vehicle appearance quality reviewer.
